front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《22》

en: Autumn day, fallen blossoms
A person stands alone
Listening to the rain, wanting to speak yet saying nothing
Walking to where the water ends
Imagining, another
A possible direction
Winter's desolate quiet
Once the snow comes
Once again a stretch of vivid, pure white
The robe's sash grows looser
There are words whose ink has not yet dried
For whom is this record kept?

points.zh:
王國維 《 人間詞話 》
古今之成大事業，大學問者，必經過三種之境界 :
第一境界 :
「昨夜西風凋碧樹，獨上高樓，望盡天涯路。」
第二境界 :
「衣帶漸寬終不悔。為伊消得人憔悴」
第三境界 :
「眾裡尋他千百度，驀然回首，那人卻在，燈火闌珊處。」
points.en:
Wang Guowei, 'Poetic Remarks in the Human World'
Throughout history, those who have accomplished great undertakings or great scholarship must pass through three realms:
The first realm:
"Last night the west wind withered the green trees; alone I climbed the high tower, gazing to the end of the road at the world's edge."
The second realm:
"My robe and belt grow ever looser, yet I regret it not — for you I am willing to grow gaunt and thin."
The third realm:
"Among the crowds I searched for her a thousand times, ten thousand times; then, suddenly turning my head, there she was, in the dim light where the lanterns wane."

en: Morning fog cannot, autumn wind cannot
If the slanting sun cannot, who can?
Coming to understand the unregretted way flowers bloom and fall
The wind rises, fallen leaves scatter and drift
Some moods
Cannot be touched, dare not be touched

zh: 何時  ?  添酒回燈再同桌
en: The Last Supper, said
Bread is forgiveness, wine is promise
When?  Pour more wine, turn the lamp back up, sit together at the table again

points.zh:
聖經 馬可福音   第14章:
他們吃的時候，耶穌拿起餅來，祝謝了就擘開，遞給門徒，說：「你們拿去吃吧，這是我的身體。」 耶穌又拿起杯來，祝謝了就遞給他們，說：「你們都喝吧， 這是我的血，是為立約的，為許多人流出來，使罪得赦。 我告訴你們，從今以後我必不再喝這葡萄酒，直到我和你們在我父的國裡，喝新酒的那一天。」
points.en:
The Bible, Gospel of Mark, Chapter 14:
As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to the disciples, saying, "Take, eat; this is my body." Then he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them, saying, "Drink from it, all of you. This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins. I tell you, I will not drink again of this fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom."

en: Tonight, my longing for you
It is a piece of jazz music
Colors abundant, lingering and turning
Morning fog, hazy and dim
There is a distant autumn sound, and once you step in
That is Monet's sunrise

points.zh: 《日出 · 印象》（Impression Sunrise）是法國印象派畫家克勞德 · 莫內于1872年創作的一幅油畫 。該畫描繪了晨霧籠罩中的日出港口景象，應用光的美妙變幻與晃動，以輕快跳躍的筆觸，展現了光在海面上反射與顫動的迷人景象。這幅作品突破了傳統題材和構圖的框架，完全以視覺經驗的感知為起點，側重表現光線變化的氛圍。這是莫内畫作中最典型的一幅，是印象畫派的經典之作，「印象畫派」名稱之由來。

flow.caption_zh: 館藏處： 法國巴黎馬摩坦博物館 Musee Marmottan, Paris

zh: 莫內這幅與「蒙娜麗莎」齊名的「印象．日出」，是 1873 年春天在法國海邊阿弗赫完成的，而「印象派」之名的產生，更是取自這幅畫的標題。莫內是描繪一個橘紅色般的太陽正緩緩昇起，水面上有三艘小艇，其中一艘僅能模糊的看出來，幾條線條表現出波浪的形狀，完全沒有過份的誇張。看到太陽掙扎著想要穿過濃霧，我們的想像開始被挑動。
en: This painting by Monet, as renowned as the 'Mona Lisa,' is 'Impression, Sunrise,' completed in the spring of 1873 at Le Havre on the French coast; indeed, the name 'Impressionism' itself was taken from this painting's title. Monet depicts an orange-red sun slowly rising, with three small boats upon the water, one of which can barely be made out; a few strokes suggest the shapes of the waves, with nothing overdone. Seeing the sun struggling to break through the thick fog, our imagination begins to stir.
--Chiang Hsun: "Decoding Monet"
Just wondering with what mood
Recalling that journey, suddenly
The Colorado night rises to mind

points.zh:
《 Moonlight On The Colorado 》
--美國民謠《科羅拉多的夜晚》
水面的漣漪不住地爍閃　
好像在對我眨着双眼
遠方的友人你是否康健　
為什麼欲語却又無言
歸來吧，朋友，回到我身邊　
月光里歌聲頻傳
悠揚的旋律緊扣我心弦
科羅拉多美麗的夜晚
